name: is_dir_empty
title: Check if a directory is empty

origin.description: This function checks whether a given directory is empty or not.

arguments.name: path
arguments.text: A character string specifying the path to the directory to check.

origin.details: This function checks whether a given directory is empty or not.
origin.value:
A logical value. Returns TRUE if the directory is empty,
FALSE otherwise.
origin.example:
empty <- file.path(tempdir(), "fs-empty-example")
full <- file.path(tempdir(), "fs-full-example")
dir_create(empty)
dir_create(full)
file_create(file.path(full, "a"))
is_dir_empty(empty)
is_dir_empty(full)
